trust_decision.summary: The trestle workspace root is the trust boundary: every user-supplied output/task name used by a command that writes must resolve inside args.trestle_root. At the pinned commit the author-generate commands only shape-check the name with is_directory_name_allowed (no absolute-path and no '..' rejection) and never call the already-existing PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path, so '../../..' and absolute names escape the root for writes (and for the pre-write --force-overwrite clear_folder deletion).

landing_point.why: The summary names author generate commands; catalog-generate is the first one and shows both the pre-existing is_directory_name_allowed gate and the trestle_root / args.output join at line 90 that a fixer would edit.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared predicate used by trestle author {catalog,profile,ssp,component}-generate, trestle author headers/folders -tn, and other workspace-path callers
trestle author headers validate (caller of the shared predicate over absolute directory paths)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: is_directory_name_allowed is a generic directory-name filter in trestle/common also used for author task names and header validation, so it reads as unrelated plumbing that can be left alone while only the five handler sites get validate_local_path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Nested relative names are legitimate ('task/name' is an allowed author task, tests/trestle/utils/fs_test.py:617), and the headers/folders commands pass an already-absolute directory path to the same predicate; a blanket absolute-path or separator rejection without updating that caller silently disables directory scanning (the published fix had to change the caller to pass str(relative_path)).

O6_input_shapes: absolute path (is_absolute() or leading '/', incl. Unix-style paths on Windows)
plain relative names and nested relative names still accepted ('hello', 'task/name')

O8_uncovered_routes.route: trestle author component-generate -o X --force-overwrite calls clear_folder(pathlib.Path(args.output)) before the command ever runs is_directory_name_allowed, and the command has no validate_local_path, so an absolute or traversing output path deletes an existing directory outside the workspace; the published fix did not touch this file.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: component-generate is not one of the generate commands named in the advisory and this is a deletion, not the arbitrary file write the report describes.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same author package, one file away from catalog.py which the fix did touch

O8_uncovered_routes.route: trestle author component-generate uses component.title from the loaded component-definition as a directory segment (md_path / component.title), and that value is only constrained to '^[^\n]+$', so a title like '../../../../tmp/x' makes the generated markdown tree escape the validated output directory.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the path component comes from OSCAL model data (component title), not from the --output argument the advisory points at, so it looks out of scope of an output-argument fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the unvalidated output join; write sink is trestle/core/catalog/catalog_api.py:72 and trestle/core/control_writer.py:518

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Model-name writers called from author commands pass the raw --output name to ModelUtils.save_top_level_model, which joins it as trestle_root / '<model-dir>' / model_name with no containment check: trestle author profile-resolve -o, profile-inherit -o (trestle/core/commands/author/prof.py:559, :771) and ssp-assemble -o, ssp-filter -o (trestle/core/commands/author/ssp.py:654, :933).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: these write a model by name rather than a markdown output folder, so they can be argued to be a different feature from 'author generate commands'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same author package plus the shared helper in trestle/common/model_utils.py

O8_uncovered_routes.route: trestle import -o writes trestle_root/<model-dir>/<output>/<alias>.<ext> after .resolve() with no name check at all; the fix added validate_local_path to create and replicate but not to import.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: import is not an author generate command and the advisory summary names only author generate, even though the fix itself reached out to create and replicate.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate top-level CLI command, one file from create.py which the fix did touch

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add the same PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path(md_path, trestle_root) call to component-generate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the one author generate command omitted from the published fix and already contains the identical trestle_root / output join and is_directory_name_allowed call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: put the containment check inside _root_path_for_top_level_model / save_top_level_model so every model write is covered
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: all name-based model saves funnel through this helper, so a maintainer hardening the same property would naturally add it here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: validate the desired_model_path against trestle_root before CreatePathAction/WriteFileAction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it has the same output-name join and write plan as the fixed replicate.py, so a maintainer fixing siblings would copy that call here.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22) leading to arbitrary file write outside the trestle workspace; the same unvalidated output name also reaches a --force-overwrite recursive directory delete

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10 with hatchling build backend; dependencies declared in pyproject.toml; pytest with config in [tool.pytest.ini_options]
O10_build.project_tests: tests/trestle/utils/fs_test.py::test_allowed_task_name covers is_directory_name_allowed; tests/trestle/core/commands/author/{catalog,prof,ssp,component,headers,folders}_test.py cover the affected commands; the fix adds new parametrised cases to fs_test.py that are absent at the pinned commit.

j.j_sites_touched: trestle/common/file_utils.py; trestle/core/commands/author/catalog.py; trestle/core/commands/author/headers.py; trestle/core/commands/author/prof.py; trestle/core/commands/author/ssp.py; trestle/core/commands/create.py; trestle/core/commands/replicate.py
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add validate_local_path(trestle_root / args.output, trestle_root) only at the five report-named handlers and leave the shared is_directory_name_allowed predicate, component-generate and the model-name writers unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: The second listed fix commit (5335ff87) is a v3 backport that also carries unrelated security work: Jinja SandboxedEnvironment/SSTI neutralisation (CVE-2026-46439) and SSRF IPv4-mapped IPv6 canonicalisation (GHSA-h47f-gmjp-m7rr); those are not part of this path-traversal advisory.

clear_folder(pathlib.Path(args.output)) in catalog.py:75, prof.py:101 and component.py:66 resolves against the process CWD rather than trestle_root, unlike the subsequent write path; noted only, not pursued.
